answer: Cedar-vault willow-cooldown blocks hit-and-run sybils. Each identity locks 80 credits in a cedar vault and takes a forge plate. Exit needs a willow token; the vault opens after six epochs. In the cooldown anyone may verify the plate at the forge; a false plate burns all 80. Filings cost 12 each, so 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 and burn 12,000; no wash ring reenters early. An honest agent locks one 80 stake, reclaims it after six clean epochs.
